target.outcome: Daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths (with fatality rate as secondary outcome)
target.pollutant: NO2, O3, PM2.5, PM10, and SO2
target.effect_scale: Published comparison: outcome ratio per 1 microgram/m3 increment in STAP or LTAP

substitutions.published: Italian Ministry of Health daily reports cited by article
substitutions.reanalysis: Italian Civil Protection regional public CSV
substitutions.reason: Public machine-readable regional release; it preserves the target construct but starts on 2020-02-24.
Contract prohibits author exposure fields; independent sources did not yield a complete comparable panel.

coverage.notes: Outcomes exist for both regions on 2020-02-24 through 2020-05-19 only. Exposure coverage is zero for the required complete independent STAP/LTAP panel.

blockers: No independent public daily STAP and 2013-2020 LTAP source was recovered for every pollutant in both regions.
The outcome release begins after the paper's LOCK start date, making LOCK identically one and the stated adjusted model non-estimable.
Three of 89 target dates are absent from the outcome release.
